base: The urge to break free can be accurate about the problem and reckless about what should replace it.
business: A practical mismatch needs adjustment; change the arrangement instead of repeating the same workaround.
shadow: Pressure escalates when each side keeps demanding terms the other cannot sustain.
arcApplying: The mismatch becomes harder to work around as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The pressure eases after exactness, leaving the changed arrangement to prove itself.

readerCopy.body: The urge to break free can be accurate about the problem and reckless about what should replace it. When Uranus squares the North Node, the old setup may become impossible to tolerate before the replacement is stable, affordable, or complete. A sudden exit can remove the restriction and also remove support you still need. Identify the specific rule, schedule, system, or dependence that has become intolerable, then change that part deliberately instead of asking one burst of frustration to design everything that comes after it.
